abilities.name: Aspect of the Viper
per_rank_text:
The hunter takes on the aspect of the viper, causing ranged and melee attacks a chance to regenerate mana.

Damage and healing done reduced by 40%. 

You gain 4% of maximum mana every 3 sec. 

@ext:Only one Aspect can be active at a time.:ext@

abilities.name: Charge
per_rank_text:
Charge an enemy, generate 12 rage, and root it for 1.5 sec.

This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

abilities.name: Titan's Grip
per_rank_text:
Allows you to wield a Two-Handed Axe, Mace, or Sword in each hand. 

Also allows for a weapon or shield to be held in the off-hand while a Staff is equipped.

Physical damage dealt is reduced by 10%.

abilities.name: Commanding Shout
Crimson Tempest
per_rank_text:
Finishing move that slashes at the flesh of all enemies within 8 yards, dealing Physical damage and causing them to bleed per combo point:
 1 point: 2 damage and 8 damage over 8 sec
 2 points: 2 damage and 8 damage over 8 sec
 3 points: 2 damage and 8 damage over 8 sec
 4 points: 2 damage and 8 damage over 8 sec
 5 points: 2 damage and 8 damage over 8 sec

abilities.name: Roll the Bones
per_rank_text:
Roll the dice of fate, providing a random lesser or great combat enhancement for 10 sec. Only one enhancement can be active at the same time.

This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

abilities.name: Tame Dragonkin
Frostbolt
per_rank_text: Launches a bolt of frost at the enemy, causing ${12*} to ${15*} Frost damage and slowing movement speed by 40% for 5 sec.

abilities.name: Create Soulstone
per_rank_text:
Creates a Minor Soulstone. The Soulstone can be used to store one target's soul. If the target dies while his soul is stored, he will be able to resurrect with 400 health and $3026q1 mana.

Conjured items disappear if logged out for more than 15 minutes.

abilities.name: Life Tap
per_rank_text: Converts 15 health into mana. Spell power increases the amount of mana returned.

abilities.name: Create Firestone
per_rank_text:
While applied to target weapon it increases damage dealt by spells by 1% and spell critical strike rating by 7. This effect lasts for 2 hours. 

You can only benefit from one Warlock weapon enchant at a time.

abilities.name: Shamanistic Rage
per_rank_text:
Reduces all damage taken by 30% and gives your successful melee and ranged attacks a chance to regenerate mana equal to 15% of your attack power. This spell is usable while stunned. Lasts 15 sec.

@ext:This ability is usable while Shapeshifted.:ext@

abilities.name: Stoneskin Totem
per_rank_text:
Summons a Stoneskin Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster. The totem protects party and raid members within 50 yards, increasing armor by 95. Lasts 5 min.

@ext:This ability is usable while shapeshifted.:ext@

abilities.name: Mana Spring Totem
Frostbrand Weapon
per_rank_text: Imbue your weapon with frost. Each hit has a chance of causing 31 additional Frost damage and slowing the target's movement speed by 50% for 8 sec. This effect lasts for 2 hours.

abilities.name: Hammer of Wrath
per_rank_text: Hurls a hammer that strikes an enemy for 351 to 387 Holy damage. Only usable on enemies that have 20% or less health.

abilities.name: Seal of Wisdom
per_rank_text:
Fills you with divine wisdom for $20166d, giving each melee auto attack a chance to restore 4% of your total mana. Only one Seal can be active at any one time.

Unleashing this Seal's energy will deal 1 Holy damage to an enemy.

abilities.name: Seal of Righteousness
per_rank_text:
Fills you with holy spirit for $21084d, granting each main hand auto attack and Paladin melee ability 1 additional Holy damage. Only one Seal can be active at any one time.

Unleashing this Seal's energy will cause 1 Holy damage to an enemy.

abilities.name: Devotion Aura
per_rank_text:
Gives 40 additional armor to party and raid members within 40 yards. 

@ext:Players may only have one Aura on them per Paladin at any one time.:ext@

abilities.name: Blood Presence
Titanic Mutilate
per_rank_text:
Instantly attacks with both weapons for 70% weapon damage. Damage is increased by 20% against bleeding targets. Awards 2 combo points.

@ext:This uses Mutilate modifiers.:ext@

abilities.name: Stormbound Cleave
per_rank_text:
A sweeping attack that does your weapon damage plus 9 as Stormstrike damage to the target and his $?s58366[two nearest allies][nearest ally].

@ext:This uses Cleave modifiers.:ext@

abilities.name: Winds of Winter
per_rank_text:
Finishing move that deals Frost damage per combo point to enemies in a cone in front of the caster:
 1 point : 2-23 damage
 2 points: 2-23 damage
 3 points: 2-23 damage
 4 points: 2-23 damage
 5 points: 2-23 damage

@ext:This uses Cone of Cold modifiers.:ext@

abilities.name: Ice Shock
per_rank_text:
Finishing move that instantly shocks the target with Frost damage, increasing per combo point:
 1 point : 16-30 damage 
 2 points: 16-30 damage
 3 points: 16-30 damage
 4 points: 16-30 damage
 5 points: 16-30 damage

@ext:This uses Frost Shock modifiers.:ext@

abilities.name: Arctis
per_rank_text:
Unleash pure frost that deals 131 Frost damage and an additional 64 Frost damage over 12 seconds.

@ext:This uses Pyroblast modifiers.:ext@

abilities.name: Glacial Spike
per_rank_text:
Summons a Glacial Spike, dealing 67 Frost damage, slows enemies by 56 to 60% for 4 sec and infects targets with Frost Fever.

@ext:This uses Cone of Cold modifiers. Damage is split when hitting more than 3 enemies.:ext@

abilities.name: Twisted Mind
per_rank_text:
Your mind becomes twisted, increasing your spell power by and your hit chance by 3%, but reduces your healing and absorbs by 5%.

@ext:This cannot be used together with other bar-changing abilities such as Stances or Forms.:ext@

abilities.name: Rocket Boots
per_rank_text:
|cFFFFFFFFThis spell belongs to |r|cFFA3A3A3Tinker|r

|cffffffff3 Charges, 30 sec recharge|r
Activate your |cffffffffRocket Boots|r launching you forwards.

abilities.name: Hydricles
per_rank_text:
Launches a bolt of frost that jumps to 5 nearby enemies, dealing 10 Frost damage and slowing their movement speed by 15% for 3 sec.

Each jump reduces the damage by ${($284854f2-1)*100*-1}%.

Max 3 charges. 8 second recharge timer. Gaining Fingers of Frost restores a charge.

@ext:This uses Frostbolt modifiers.:ext@

abilities.name: Holy Slash
per_rank_text:
A strong attack that increases melee damage by 11 as Holystrike damage and causes a high amount of threat.

@ext:This uses Heroic Strike modifiers.:ext@
